invariants.rationale: The method always returns a String, either from substring or the empty string, never null.
String.length() is always non-negative for any non-null String.
If the result is empty, it must be the empty string; covers both the empty case and non-empty with substring.
The returned substring length or empty string will not exceed the source text's length.
If not the empty string, result is derived from text and appears as a substring within text.
